title: Fridays for Future climate protest in Hamburg
seoTitle: Hamburg climate protest by Fridays for Future

tea.why: Protesters gathered to demand stronger climate action, criticize government inaction, and urge adherence to global climate targets.
tea.want: Faster expansion of renewable energy, reliable public transport, and social-ecological building renovations.
tea.changed: Nov 13: Protesters marched through Hamburg's inner city, forming human letters to spell out a message to the Chancellor.

summary: Organised by Fridays for Future, a climate demonstration took place in Hamburg, drawing a crowd that mixed older participants with younger attendees. Alongside the host movement, groups such as BUND, Omas gegen rechts, Verdi, and ATIF participated. Participants criticized federal inaction on climate change, referencing heatwave fatalities and the Chancellor's absence from the climate conference in Antalya. Protesters marched from Ballindamm through the inner city towards the Rathausmarkt, demanding a quicker transition to renewable energy, better public transport, and climate-friendly building renovations. Police stated that everything proceeded peacefully.
demands: A functional and reliable public transport system
Climate-friendly and socially just building renovations
Prioritizing climate protection on the political agenda
response: According to police, the demonstration proceeded entirely peacefully with no disruptions.

crowd.text: 3.000 Leute sind in Hamburg gekommen (taz.de); Polizei: etwa 2.800 Menschen (ndr.de)

updates.text: Demonstrators gathered at Ballindamm in Hamburg for the start of the climate protest.
Participants marched past the main railway station and Mönckebergstraße towards Rathausmarkt.
Police reported that approximately 2,800 people participated in the march peacefully.

conflicts: Organizers and stage reports claimed around 3,000 attendees, while police estimated the crowd at roughly 2,800.
